operator_notes: Weekly bulletin is the churchmedia.tv 'View Our Latest Newsletter' button on St Patrick's Ballyphilip (st-patricks-church-2).
GET /api/getChannelAbout?slug=st-patricks-church-2 → data.newsletter_url. The path token and ?cb= cache-buster change every upload — never pin them.
Harvester HTTP-fetches that JSON first (no browser). Playwright click of the newsletter button is the fallback.
Same week's file is also overwritten at portaferryparish.com/images/downloads/Bulletin2019A.pdf (Joomla pdf.js viewer) — last-resort HTTP fallback only when the churchmedia API/PDF fails.
Probed 21/08/2026: current file Sunday 23rd August 2026 (Twenty-First Sunday in Ordinary Time), 5 pages, Last-Modified 20/08/2026. Dead pinned token was ovt7qm?cb=1786005944 (returned HTML).
do_not: Do not pin churchmedia /newsletter/<token>.st-patricks-church-2.pdf?cb=... — the token dies on the next upload.
Do not use st-patricks-ballygalget — that is a different church livestream in the same parish.
Do not download the Angular SPA HTML for a dead /newsletter/<token>.pdf (returns text/html).
Do not treat Bulletin2019A.pdf's 2019 as a year — it is a static overwrite filename.
